nodeDetails.title: Node.js
nodeDetails.intro: I use Node.js across backend and frontend development, as well as for command-line tools and automation. I aim to keep each project environment reproducible and appropriate for its dependencies.
nodeDetails.versionDescription: I use nvm to quickly switch to the Node.js version required by each project without reinstalling the runtime.
nodeDetails.dockerDescription: I prefer Alpine-based Node.js images for services with minimal requirements. When a project relies on native libraries or requires broader compatibility, I use Debian-based images.
nodeDetails.pnpmDescription: I prefer pnpm for dependency management and keep explicit control over scripts executed during installation, especially when working with third-party packages.
nodeDetails.approachDescription: I keep environments lightweight when possible, while prioritizing compatibility and reproducibility when the project requires it.

awsDetails.title: Amazon Web Services
awsDetails.intro: I have used AWS across different projects to build, deploy, and integrate cloud-based solutions. I have practical experience with several AWS services and use them according to the needs of each system.
awsDetails.servicesDescription: These are AWS services I have worked with directly in development and integration workflows.
awsDetails.learning: I am comfortable working with these services and learning or adopting additional AWS services when a project requires them.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I build, maintain, and improve products and systems, from MVPs to existing platforms and scalable solutions.

content.paragraph1: I work flexibly across frontend, backend, AWS, and integrations with external services. I choose technologies based on the problem, performance, and maintainability, and I use artificial intelligence to accelerate development, analysis, automation, and prototyping with technical validation.
content.paragraph2: I am comfortable moving across different areas of a project, researching new tools, and independently resolving the blockers I can control. When a decision may affect the system's future evolution, I prefer to validate it before introducing unnecessary complexity or technical debt.

projects.title: A few projects I have been working on
projects.description: A selection of recent projects that reflect the kind of products, tools, and solutions I enjoy building.

itemTen.title: KineWall — Android
itemTen.description: Native Android video live wallpaper app that lets users select a local video and apply it as a live wallpaper, with infinite looping, muted playback, and configurable scaling modes.

itemNine.title: KineWall — KDE Plasma 6
itemNine.tech: QML + KDE Plasma 6 + Qt 6 + Qt Multimedia
itemNine.description: QML video wallpaper plugin for KDE Plasma 6 that plays local videos in a continuous loop without audio and can automatically pause playback when a maximized window covers the desktop.

itemEight.title: MCP Shell Sudo
itemEight.description: Linux MCP server created for LM Studio to be used locally with Qwen and Gemma 4, because the alternatives I tried did not support sudo. It executes local commands, including sudo.

itemSeven.title: OBS Voice Isolator
itemSeven.tech: C + CMake + PowerShell + OBS Studio Plugin
itemSeven.description: Native OBS Studio audio filter that reduces noise, suppresses breathing, and isolates speech with optional two-microphone cancellation.

itemSix.title: Orqent
itemSix.tech: TypeScript + Node.js + React Ink + Ollama + Local models
itemSix.description: Hobby and practice project focused on learning how to run AI models locally and orchestrate tools according to clear runtime specifications. Built as a local-first terminal agent with conversation history, reasoning control, tool calling, and explicit execution boundaries.

itemFive.title: Multi-WhatsApp
itemFive.description: Desktop application that manages multiple concurrent WhatsApp Web sessions with persistent session handling and fast account switching. Built with Electron + Node.js, solving session isolation, state persistence, and multi-instance control.

itemFour.title: Mine Hammers
itemFour.description: A Minecraft mod written in Java that adds hammer-based area mining mechanics for more efficient resource gathering.

itemThree.title: Mine Excavators
itemThree.description: A Minecraft mod written in Java that adds excavator-style tools for faster terrain and block clearing.

itemTwo.title: Personal Portfolio
itemTwo.tech: Next.js 16 + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI
itemTwo.description: A personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, and experience with a modern UI and responsive layout.

itemOne.title: ArtesLafaux - Landing Page
itemOne.tech: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI + Vite
itemOne.description: Landing page for a digital artist, featuring an image gallery, contact section, and responsive design.
